news.og_desc: Manchester United's decline is no longer merely a passing crisis of results or a stumble that can be overcome with a single win, after the team found itself in a highly dangerous area of the Premier League table, amid a series of failures that have brought back to mind relegation scenarios that never used to cross the minds of its fans. After nine rounds, the historic club stands on shocking figures, placing it before difficult questions about its future, about its players' ability to pull it out of its crisis, and even about the possibility of sliding into a survival battle among the Premier League's giants.
